text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much for your hard work
handling things since midnight.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I have merely fulfilled my natural duty.
...With that, I shall take my leave."
choice_data_list: Haven't you been getting enough rest?
Haven't you been getting enough rest?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Good morning.
I was attending to an urgent matter, you see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However, I have taken the minimum necessary rest. I believe there is no need to adjust the training regimen. ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Daiichi Ruby was sleep-deprived from dealing with the issue.
